cards.name: Glimmerhold
cards.quote: Glimmerhold gleams like a hidden jewel in the stone, bright with the memory of deep craft.

cards.name: Aldenburg
cards.quote: The first riders of Horse Plains raised Aldenburg before any other hall, and its gates still open eastward out of old habit.

cards.name: The Seeing Hill
cards.quote: The Seeing Hill crowns the river with a stern eye, as if watching for the same doom that once came south.

cards.name: The Hearing Hill
cards.quote: The Hearing Hill watches the vale with a stillness that can outlast kingdoms.

cards.name: Songhill
cards.quote: Songhill gleams with the old patience of a watchman who has seen the dusk before.

cards.name: Windtop
cards.quote: Windtop remembers moonlight, blade, and the long ache of old days.

cards.name: Ironford
cards.quote: Ironford carries the iron memory of the mountains, where work and warning have always stood together.

cards.name: Redstone Camp
cards.quote: Redstone Camp is a dark hold of old metal and older grudges, and the stone remembers every strike.

cards.name: Old Kingshold
cards.quote: The stones of Old Kingshold wait in silence for the hand that shall wake them.

cards.name: Hillcross
cards.quote: Hillcross lies quiet beneath the hills, but the ground there still knows the tread of ancient feet.

cards.name: Saltwatch
cards.quote: The shipwrights of Saltwatch lay keels for the Corsairs and take their price in favours, not coin.

cards.name: Ashwatch
cards.quote: Ashwatch is ash-bright and watchful, as if the land had learned to glare back at the sun.

cards.name: Ironhall
cards.quote: At Ironhall, the walls are stern, and the silence is the silence of deep craft.

cards.name: Weftspire
cards.quote: Weftspire keeps a dark and sinking quiet, and few cross it without care.

cards.name: Black Tower
cards.quote: Above the ash fields, the Black Tower watches roads that no traveller walks freely.

cards.name: Southwatch Tower
cards.quote: Southwatch Tower lifts a grim tower over the waste, and its shadow reaches farther than its walls.

cards.name: Wraithtower
cards.quote: Wraithtower stands like a dark sentinel over the waste, its shadow long with command.

cards.name: Deepwatch
cards.quote: Deepwatch keeps the grave look of the hills, as if it had been hewn to outlast grief.

cards.name: The Cairnfields
cards.quote: Slavefort crouches over Slave Fields like a black horn of the earth, and no light lingers long beside it.

cards.name: Broadforge
cards.quote: The hard places of Broadforge seem to answer only to patience and long memory.

cards.name: Bearhall
cards.quote: Bearhall stands as a stronghold of hearth and stern hospitality, where the bears’ memory is never far.

cards.name: Crossway
cards.quote: Crossway keeps faith with the road, though the years grow wary.

cards.name: Bramblemarch
cards.quote: At Bramblemarch the evening stillness is kept like a lamp in the window.

cards.name: Woodbridge
cards.quote: Woodbridge shelters its people beneath the wood, where the trees are old enough to judge strangers.

cards.name: Burnt Crossing
cards.quote: Burnt Crossing lies far from easy roads, where the silence of the land feels deliberate.

cards.name: Millpond
cards.quote: Millpond sits at the crossing of roads and the meeting of waters, and does not forget either.

cards.name: Foamisle
cards.quote: Foamisle holds the river like a spear-point, watching north and south with hard patience.

cards.name: Tidefort
cards.quote: Half the cargo of Tidefort is salt and fish; the ledgers do not say what the other half is.

cards.name: High Bluff
cards.quote: High Bluff rises over the fields like a warning that never forgot how to speak.

cards.name: The Iron Jaws
cards.quote: The Iron Jaws lies under a cruel name, and the stones there have not forgiven.

cards.name: Redhorn Pass
cards.quote: At Redhorn Pass, the walls are stern, and the silence is the silence of deep craft.
cards.actionEffect: The Cruel Mountain turns on those who trespass. Own mountain natives buffed. Own non-native mountain slowed. Enemy mountain emissaries gain Arcane Insight. Enemy mountain units 30-40% frozen; commanders halted.

cards.name: Amberhold
cards.quote: In Amberhold, the trees keep their own counsel, and none should presume to answer for them.

cards.name: Greenhaven
cards.quote: Greenhaven watches from the black wood as if the trees themselves had been set to guard a secret.

cards.name: Silverwatch
cards.quote: Beneath its boughs, Silverwatch keeps memory bright and still.

cards.name: Pearl Harbour
cards.quote: Pearl Harbour glows with a pale remnant of grandeur, though time has thinned its banners.

cards.name: Southhaven Isle
cards.quote: Southhaven Isle clings to the sea-wind with the stubborn grace of stone weathered but unbroken.

cards.name: Frostkeep
cards.quote: Frostkeep stands hard against the North, and even its ruin looks carved for endurance.

cards.name: Redwall
cards.quote: Redwall holds itself like a fortress of old resolve, half-buried in memory and rain.

cards.name: Woodhill
cards.quote: At Woodhill, the boughs bend low enough to listen, but not to forgive.

cards.name: Silverbourne
cards.quote: At Silverbourne, the boughs bend low enough to listen, but not to forgive.

cards.name: Silverfast
cards.quote: Silverfast stands where the veins run thin but the will of its makers runs deep.

cards.name: The Golden Mound
cards.quote: The Golden Mound rises above Goldenwood, where the fallen are remembered beneath living branches.

cards.name: The Weft Stair
cards.quote: The Weft Stair is a soft place, and its softness is the first of its deceits.

cards.name: Crook Hollow
cards.quote: Crook Hollow lies quiet under hedge and hill, a hidden door for those who must travel unseen.

cards.name: Dalemoot
cards.quote: Dalemoot keeps the memory of the Long Lake and the mountain road, bright with trade and hard with loss.

cards.name: The Drowned Fen
cards.quote: The reeds about The Drowned Fen whisper like witnesses who would rather not be named.

cards.name: The Forest Circle
cards.quote: The Forest Circle shelters the ancient wood with a silence that feels almost vowed.

cards.name: Blackwood Keep
cards.quote: Blackwood Keep festers under the trees, and the wood around it seems to draw a darker breath.

cards.name: Swanhold
cards.quote: Swanhold shines like a white helm set upon the sea, bright against the long road of dusk.

cards.name: Oldgrowth Forest
cards.quote: The hush of Oldgrowth Forest is deep as root and as old as the first road through the dark.

cards.name: Dunbarrow
cards.quote: Dunbarrow lies in the mountains like a grave that has chosen to stand upright.

cards.name: Blackfort
cards.quote: Blackfort clings to the Emyn Muil with a grim old patience, and its black height still dares the sky.

cards.name: The Skyrie
cards.quote: High on the eyrie the Eagles keep a lonely watch.

cards.name: Easterfold
cards.quote: Easterfold lies open to wind and horse-track, and its fields remember riders before plowmen.

cards.name: Elven Haven
cards.quote: The broken haven still hears the sea in its sleep.

cards.name: Kingshall
cards.quote: Kingshall keeps its golden roofs against the sky, and the wind there still remembers riders.

cards.name: Amberport
cards.quote: Amberport is ringed with a quiet that makes every hoofbeat sound like trespass.

cards.name: Starlight Tower
cards.quote: Starlight Tower keeps its gaze westward, as if memory itself were a star.

cards.name: Moorhall
cards.quote: Moorhall holds the road with the stubborn silence of a place that has buried too many names.

cards.name: Lonely Mountain (Lost)
cards.quote: Lonely Mountain (Lost) keeps its noble outline even in ruin, like a crown left in ash.

cards.name: The Oathstone
cards.quote: The Oathstone remembers the oath-stones, and even the wind there speaks with old restraint.

cards.name: Blackwold
cards.quote: Blackwold remembers every axe raised against it. Its roots hold fast.

cards.name: Merehaven
cards.quote: Merehaven gleams on the water's edge, bright enough to tempt memory and fire alike.

cards.name: Wealdwatch Camp
cards.quote: Wealdwatch Camp sits at the edge of the Weald like a hesitant footstep beside an ancient mind.

cards.name: Whitestrand
cards.quote: The bells of Whitestrand ring for the tide as faithfully as for the King.

cards.name: Fenngate
cards.quote: At Fenngate, the water is still enough to hide danger and patient enough to keep it.

cards.name: Northhaven
cards.quote: Northhaven faces the western sea with the old patience of the Eldar, and its shore is never idle.

cards.name: Kingsfast
cards.quote: Kingsfast lies like a fallen crown upon the North.

cards.name: Rimewatch
cards.quote: Under the hard sky of Rimewatch, even silence has a stern voice.

cards.name: Dragonwatch
cards.quote: Dragonwatch keeps a stern watch over the river-country, as if Fram’s old strength had never loosened its grip.

cards.name: Stonefield
cards.quote: Stonefield clings to the high shoulders of the mountains, and its herdsmen count old grudges as carefully as their goats.
cards.actionEffect: The Cruel Mountain turns on those who trespass. Own mountain natives buffed. Own non-native mountain slowed. Enemy mountain emissaries gain Arcane Insight. Enemy mountain units 30-40% frozen; commanders halted.

cards.name: Highwood
cards.quote: Highwood stands where the forest climbs the mountain, and its sentries walk on branch and battlement alike.

cards.name: The Irisfields
cards.quote: The The Irisfields lie hushed, where water and reed keep old secrets.

cards.name: The Under Gate
cards.quote: The Under Gate gnaws at the pass like a broken fang, and the dark beyond it is never still.

cards.name: Frostwatch Keep
cards.quote: Frostwatch Keep opens beneath the sky, and there is little there to soften the eye of war.

cards.name: Goblin Mountain
cards.quote: Goblin Mountain bears the deep memory of the North, grim as a mountain scar that never closed.

cards.name: Southhaven
cards.quote: Southhaven stands by tide or river as if waiting for something that has not yet named itself.

cards.name: The Corsair Coast Havens
cards.quote: The The Corsair Coast Havens smile to the sea like a bright knife hidden in silk.

cards.name: The Deepgard
cards.quote: The Deepgard bears the mark of war, yet its walls still answer with iron courage.

cards.name: The Sunset Window
cards.quote: The Sunset Window hides the stream in shadow, as though the land itself guarded the hidden door.

cards.name: Hollyburrow
cards.quote: The green of Hollyburrow seems soft, yet it has a watchful heart.

cards.name: Starwatch
cards.quote: Starwatch is quiet under the east wind, and its stillness feels like a warning held back.

cards.name: Sunwatch
cards.quote: Sunwatch feels like a hall built for men who kept faith when the world forgot them.

cards.name: Hidden Refuge
cards.quote: In Hidden Refuge grief is borne as song, and not as burden.

cards.name: South Quay
cards.quote: South Quay feels like a gate forgotten by empire and remembered by none but crows.

cards.name: Dune Market
cards.quote: Dune Market guards its own heat and dust, a place where the desert has learned to keep secrets.

cards.name: Slave Barracks
cards.quote: Slave Barracks grips the hills in black silence, where no bird lingers long.

cards.name: Sandfort
cards.quote: Sandfort keeps its gates shut against the noon heat and opens them to the evening caravans.

cards.name: Oasis Keep
cards.quote: Oasis Keep clings to the edge of the southern heat, where even shadow seems worn thin.

cards.name: Steppe Camp
cards.quote: Steppe Camp drinks the sun and gives back only heat, dust, and hard intent.

cards.name: Deepdelve
cards.quote: Deepdelve endures in buried majesty, and the dark below it still rings with memory.

cards.name: Copper Gorge
cards.quote: At Copper Gorge, the water runs clear and the ore runs true, and both are hoarded with equal care.

cards.name: Ash Camp
cards.quote: The watch-orcs of Ash Camp squint across the ash of The Emberpit, counting every spark the Mountain throws.

cards.name: Kraghold
cards.quote: The snows above Kraghold are trampled black, for its garrison never sleeps and never leaves.

cards.name: Horse Market
cards.quote: Horse Market sits under a low sky, and the wind there sounds almost like counsel.

cards.name: Blackfort Camp
cards.quote: Blackfort Camp lies under a restless sky, and the stillness there feels earned by threat.

cards.name: Cinder Camp
cards.quote: Cinder Camp watches from a barren reach, half-fortress and half-buried warning.

cards.name: Eastern Harbour
cards.quote: Eastern Harbour keeps its own counsel, where the earth is old and the paths are few.

cards.name: Moor Market
cards.quote: From Moor Market the war-bands of Wyldmoor gather, and the smoke of their forges drifts down the dale.

cards.name: Deep Quarry
cards.quote: Deep Quarry endures like an old work of Dwarven hands, sure, severe, and unbending.

cards.name: Riverhaven
cards.quote: Riverhaven keeps its harbor face to the tides, with Sunlands’s old courage under the salt air.

cards.name: Greymouth Haven
cards.quote: Lond Daer still leans upon the river, as though the age of ships were not yet done.

cards.name: Dustfort
cards.quote: Dustfort crouches beneath the old shadow, waiting with the patience of iron.

cards.name: Slavefort
cards.quote: Slavefort crouches beneath the old shadow, waiting with the patience of iron.

cards.name: Rivermeet
cards.quote: Rivermeet holds its river crossing like a clasp of iron, small but unwilling to break.

cards.name: Marlbourne High
cards.quote: Men of the North Downs say Marlbourne High was built to watch one star, and fell when that star was no longer watched.

cards.name: Palmford
cards.quote: Palmford keeps the old road under a guarded sky, and every stone there seems to have a watcher.

cards.name: Great Delving
cards.quote: Great Delving stands small to the eye, yet stout in the keeping of the Thornhollow.

cards.name: Ashen Spire
cards.quote: Ashen Spire watches from a black spur of the Mountains of Ash, and nothing crosses the grey slopes beneath it unmarked.

cards.name: The Pale City
cards.quote: The Pale City burns with a pale malice, and the road to it seems to remember fear.

cards.name: Sunspire
cards.quote: Sunspire rises white against the long shadow of the East, steadfast as a horn-call at dawn.

cards.name: Mornspire
cards.quote: Mornspire stands in stern splendor, and its towers hold the wind like a vow.

cards.name: Eastport
cards.quote: The riders of Eastport break their horses on the open steppe, and their bargains wherever it profits them.

cards.name: The Ironmaw
cards.quote: The Ironmaw stands unyielding, a gate that has learned to answer only to ruin.

cards.name: Blackroot Post
cards.quote: Blackroot Post stands as if carved from the will of the men who would not yield the river-road.

cards.name: The Emberwound
cards.quote: The Emberwound broods in fire and ash, as though the mountain itself had grown a bitter heart.

cards.name: Mount Frostfang
cards.quote: Mount Frostfang stands with a dwarf-fast stubbornness, as though the hill itself had taken a vow.

cards.name: Silver Valley
cards.quote: From the flets of Silver Valley the wardens mark every shadow that creeps out of the mountains toward the Golden Wood.

cards.name: Dustwell
cards.quote: Dustwell shelters a stillness that feels earned, as though hardship had taken root and stayed.

cards.name: The Swanfens
cards.quote: The reeds of The Swanfens hide fires that cannot be found twice by the same path.
cards.actionEffect: The Cruel Mountain turns on those who trespass. Own mountain natives buffed. Own non-native mountain slowed. Enemy mountain emissaries gain Arcane Insight. Enemy mountain units 30-40% frozen; commanders halted.

cards.name: Deepforge
cards.quote: Deepforge rings with the memory of smiths, and its broken halls still listen for the hammer.

cards.name: Northdelve
cards.quote: In the northern dark, the old delvings still yield to those who speak the true names of stone.

cards.name: Slave Mills
cards.quote: Slave Mills stands in a country that has taught itself to endure by never sleeping.

cards.name: Pale Outpost
cards.quote: Pale Outpost keeps its old hush by the water, and the reeds there seem to remember names.

cards.name: The Elderwood
cards.quote: The The Elderwood is older than the road, and not all old things are kindly.

cards.name: Scorched Hold
cards.quote: Scorched Hold is a thorn of a place, sharp enough to turn away easy hope.

cards.name: Slave Fields Watch
cards.quote: Slave Fields Watch feels like a watch-post left standing after the rest of a kingdom was taken away.

cards.name: Thornspire
cards.quote: Thornspire stands black and precise, as if stone itself had been taught arrogance.

cards.name: Starholt
cards.quote: Starholt bears its wounds openly, yet the river still remembers the city that once was.

cards.name: Old Elven City
cards.quote: Bandits out of Wyldmoor now camp in the courts of Old Elven City, warming their hands in the ruin of the old forge-courts.

cards.name: Ashhold
cards.quote: Ashhold keeps its secrets in the stone, where even echoes seem cautious.

cards.name: Redrock Fort
cards.quote: Redrock Fort keeps the feel of a place where power once walked and still leaves its footprints.

cards.name: The Dead Roads
cards.quote: The The Dead Roads still feel the chill of unbreathed oaths, and no cheer lingers there.

cards.name: Kingsquay
cards.quote: Kingsquay wears the scars of trade and war alike, yet the tide still brings and carries its memory.

cards.name: Corsair Keep
cards.quote: Corsair Keep stands between sea and memory, a place where old trade routes left more than footprints.

cards.name: Reaver Hold
cards.quote: At Reaver Hold, the water carries old news, and none can tell which tidings are friendly.

cards.name: Shorewatch
cards.quote: Shorewatch's shepherds watch the long grass-hills of Longstrand, where news of the wide world arrives a season late.

cards.name: Mossgable
cards.quote: In Mossgable, the trees keep their own counsel, and none should presume to answer for them.

cards.name: Amberwatch
cards.quote: Amberwatch lies beneath the weight of old kings, and the stones still know their names.

cards.name: Vineyard Landing
cards.quote: Vineyard Landing is crossed by old rumors and older streams, and neither has lost its way.

cards.name: Slave Fields Storehouse
cards.quote: Slave Fields Storehouse sits like a watchfire long gone cold, but the ground around it still knows watchfulness.

cards.name: Stoneford
cards.quote: At Stoneford the river keeps the western gate.

cards.name: Blossomford
cards.quote: Blossomford lies by the water like a watching stone, patient and unadorned.

cards.name: Raven Stair
cards.quote: Raven Stair crouches beneath the forest edge, where tree-shadow and river-mist meet in secrecy.

cards.name: Cinderfort
cards.quote: Snow lies deep on the walls of Cinderfort, and at sundown the garrison reads red omens in it.

cards.name: The Weaver's Lair
cards.quote: The Weaver's Lair breathes with old malice, and even the stone seems to shy from the dark within it.

cards.name: Vintners' Hall
cards.quote: Vintners' Hall broods in silence, as if the dark there had learned to wait.

cards.name: Stockleigh
cards.quote: Stockleigh keeps watch upon the Bramblemarch road, where a lamp in the window still means comfort against the dark.

cards.name: Stowbury
cards.quote: In Stowbury the horses are stabled nearer the hearth than the men, and no one thinks it strange.

cards.name: Great Steppe Camp
cards.quote: Great Steppe Camp keeps the hard memory of a road where riders once vanished into dust.

cards.name: Lakewatch
cards.quote: The Rangers of Lakewatch mend their grey cloaks by fires that cast no light beyond the palisade.

cards.name: Copperhall
cards.quote: Copperhall watches the western road, and its lanterns have guided many a kinsman home.

cards.name: Old Bridge
cards.quote: Great piers of stone still stride across the Greyflood at Old Bridge, carrying a bridge that ends in air.

cards.name: The Wedge
cards.quote: Between Hoarwell and Loudwater the Firstbloods of the Angle keep their hidden watch, remembered by few and forgetting nothing.

cards.name: The Crag
cards.quote: The Crag rises from the river like a held breath, old as the ford beneath it.

cards.name: The Giantmoors
cards.quote: The fogs of the Ettenmoors roll downhill like a tide, and what walks within them is best left unnamed.

cards.name: The Last Quays
cards.quote: The Last Quays look west with a sorrow that has long since learned grace.

cards.name: The Deepholes
cards.quote: The Deepholes keep what the Chief does not wish spoken of â€” and those who spoke too freely.

cards.name: The Troll Thickets
cards.quote: Three shapes of weathered stone stand in the Trollshaws yet, quarrelling forever over how to cook their supper.

cards.name: Stonehall
cards.quote: Stonehall rings with hammer blows by day and quiet songs by night.

cards.name: The Woodking's Halls
cards.quote: The hush of The Woodking's Halls is deep as root and as old as the first road through the dark.

cards.name: Warwatch
cards.quote: Warwatch bears the mark of old terror, and the land around it has not forgotten the touch.

cards.name: Amber Isle
cards.quote: Amber Isle stands above the eastern sea, a last landmark before open water.

cards.name: Moorfarm
cards.quote: Moorfarm keeps a harvest behind its fences and a watchman at the gate.

cards.name: Slave Fields Garrison
cards.quote: Slave Fields Garrison endures in the heat with a rough and stubborn silence, like a camp that refused to die.

cards.name: War Camp
cards.quote: War Camp squats upon the battle-plain like a camp that forgot to move on, its wells dug between old spears.

cards.name: Far Southport
cards.quote: The trees of Far Southport grow down to the tide line, and what is unloaded beneath them is never spoken of in the ports of the north.

cards.name: Southford
cards.quote: Southford leans into the wind with a grim pride that refuses to be bent.

cards.name: Westerfold
cards.quote: Westerfold opens to the plains with a stubborn calm that no storm has taught to bow.

cards.name: Woodfolk Steading
cards.quote: Woodfolk Steading keeps a plain folk-stead’s courage, with smoke, timber, and the watch of the woods about it.

cards.name: Blackdelve
cards.quote: The western halls remember the hammer, though few now walk their deep ways.
